trans-unit.source: We drove the enemy off thanks to Pegasus.
trans-unit.target: We drove the enemy off thanks to Pegasus.

trans-unit.source: It'd be so cool if my broom could always fly like it did.
trans-unit.target: It'd be so cool if my broom could always fly like it did.

trans-unit.source: Then there's the Mana Cannon... Magitechnology is frighteningly powerful.
trans-unit.target: Then there's the Mana Cannon... Magitechnology is frighteningly powerful.

trans-unit.source: Yes. I feel I now understand why Dhaos is fighting so persistently.
trans-unit.target: Yes. I feel I now understand why Dhaos is fighting so persistently.

trans-unit.source: Anyway, time to strike while the iron's hot.
trans-unit.target: Anyway, time to strike while the iron's hot.
